description: The hidden webview a desktop motion render drives (src/motion.rs): the render page inside it may invoke exactly two commands — motion_render_frame posts one captured png, motion_render_done ends the run. Nothing else is reachable from the page; the origins it can ever load are re-checked natively before the window exists (the app's own server or loopback). The open server, when it is not on loopback, gets this capability for its exact origin at runtime (src/server.rs).
